content.short: Harvest.art is a tax loss harvesting service for NFTs and tokens that have gone to zero.
content.description: Harvest.art streamlines the offloading of underperforming NFTs by letting you quickly sell or transfer assets to realize tax losses. By enabling the sale of NFTs that have declined in value, it helps lower your taxable income while preserving a smooth user experience. Connect your wallet to browse your NFTs and tokens across 7+ networks at once, unlocking tax-saving opportunities across ecosystems. This feature set is designed to help you manage value-driven tax strategies across major networks without sacrificing ease of use.
